description: Comprehensive guide of 30 European universities accepting international students from Kazakhstan, featuring application deadlines, required documents, age limits, top majors, funding/costs in KZT, visa issues, and exam scores.

universities.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
universities.age_limitations: No upper age limit; applicants must typically have completed secondary school (minimum 17-18 years old).
universities.study_costs_original: Semester fees approx. €150-300, plus non-EU tuition fees in Bavaria approx. €4,000-€6,000 per semester for certain programs.
universities.study_costs_tenge: Approx. 79,500 - 159,000 KZT per semester (plus €4,000-€6,000 or ~2,120,000 - 3,180,000 KZT per semester for non-EU tuition where applicable)
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Blocked account (Sperrkonto) required with €11,904/year (~6,309,210 KZT). Scholarships via DAAD and TUM Stipendium.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Blocked account: Approx. 6,309,210 KZT required annually. Scholarships range from partial fee waivers to monthly stipends of €300 - €930 (~159,000 - 492,900 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Extremely competitive admission, high cost of living and housing shortage in Munich, bureaucratic visa appointment delays.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Aptitude assessment procedure or interview depending on the bachelor's program.
universities.required_gpa: High (German equivalent 2.0 or better, GPA roughly 4.5/5.0 or 90%+).

universities.name: Delft University of Technology (TU Delft)
required_documents: High school diploma with strong math/physics grades
universities.study_costs_original: Non-EU tuition approx. €15,000 - €22,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Student visa sponsored by university. Limited scholarships (Justus & Louise van Effen).
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Excellence scholarships cover full tuition + living expenses (~€25,000/year or ~13,250,000 KZT). Regular living proof requires ~€12,000/year (~6,360,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Severe housing crisis in the Netherlands making it very hard to find accommodation before arrival.

sat.overall: Required for Aerospace Engineering (SAT Math score 650+).

act.overall: Accepted as alternative for specific engineering tracks.

universities.university_entrance_exams: Faculty entrance exam / online math test for specific engineering majors.
universities.required_gpa: High GPA, strong emphasis on Math and Physics (typically 4.5+/5.0).

universities.name: University of Amsterdam (UvA)
required_documents: Letter of Motivation / Statement of Purpose
universities.study_costs_original: Non-EU tuition approx. €10,000 - €17,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: University assists with entry visa/residence permit. Amsterdam Excellence Scholarships (AES).
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: AES scholarship covers full tuition and living expenses (~€25,000/year or ~13,250,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Extremely difficult housing market in Amsterdam; high overall cost of living.

sat.overall: Required for selective programs like PPE or Economics (approx 1250+).

universities.university_entrance_exams: Decentralized selection tests or matching questionnaires for specific bachelor programs.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano
required_documents: High school diploma with academic transcripts
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition based on family income (ISEE), max approx. €3,900 per year for non-EU students.
universities.study_costs_tenge: Approx. 0 - 2,067,000 KZT per year (adjustable based on financial need).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Universitaly pre-enrollment. DSU scholarship provides tuition waiver and living stipend up to €7,000/year.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: DSU Scholarship provides complete tuition waiver + stipend of up to €7,000/year (~3,710,000 KZT/year).
universities.common_problems: Bureaucratic delays with Italian embassy/consulate visa issuance and codice fiscale acquisition.

sat.overall: Recommended or required for engineering/architecture evaluation (score 1000+).

universities.university_entrance_exams: Polimi's English TOL (Test On Line) required if SAT is not submitted.

universities.name: University of Bologna
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition approx. €1,500 - €3,500 per year (adjustable via family income documentation).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Regional ER.GO scholarships available for housing and tuition waivers + stipend up to €6,500/year.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: ER.GO Scholarship provides fee waivers and living stipends up to ~€6,500/year (~3,445,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: High competition for regional scholarships and student housing; bureaucratic hurdles.

sat.overall: Not strictly mandatory unless specified by degree course.

universities.university_entrance_exams: Tolc tests (Tolc-I, Tolc-E, etc.) or departmental entry tests required.

universities.name: Masaryk University
universities.study_costs_original: Free for Czech programs; English programs range from €2,000 to €10,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Long-term student visa. Government scholarships and faculty merit stipends.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Merit scholarships range from €1,000 to €3,000/year (~530,000 - 1,590,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Complex and lengthy Czech visa processing times (60-120 days).
universities.university_entrance_exams: Faculty-specific entrance exams (biology/chemistry for medicine, aptitude tests for others).

universities.name: Charles University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for English programs ranges from €3,000 to €15,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Czech student visa. University accommodation subsidies and academic achievement grants.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Internal grants cover partial housing or tuition discounts of up to €2,000/year (~1,060,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Strict nostrification process for high school diplomas from Kazakhstan.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Mandatory faculty entrance examinations (written multiple-choice tests in science/humanities).

universities.name: University of Warsaw
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for English programs ranges from €2,100 to €4,500 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: National Polish D-type visa. Ignacy Łukasiewicz and NAWA scholarships.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: NAWA scholarships provide full tuition waivers + monthly stipends of ~PLN 1,500 (~180,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Language barrier outside major university hubs; documentation apostille requirements.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Evaluation based on high school grades; some programs require online interviews.

universities.name: Jagiellonian University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €2,500 to €14,000 per year (medical is highest).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Polish student visa. NAWA scholarship opportunities.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: NAWA scholarships provide monthly stipend support (~180,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Securing visa appointment dates in Kazakhstan can be challenging in summer.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Competitive entrance tests for medical and specialized scientific tracks.

universities.name: University of Tartu
required_documents: Secondary school graduation certificate and transcripts
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €3,500 to €5,500 per year (many tuition waivers for top applicants).
universities.study_costs_tenge: Approx. 1,855,000 - 2,915,000 KZT per year (free if tuition waiver is awarded).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Temporary Residence Permit for Study in Estonia. State scholarships and tuition waivers.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: State scholarships provide monthly living allowances of ~€350 (~185,500 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Cold climate, strict deadlines for document translation and courier submission.

sat.overall: Accepted for certain bachelor programs (SAT math/reading score minimums).

universities.university_entrance_exams: Motivation letters, online admission tests, or interviews.

universities.name: Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech)
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition approx. €3,500 - €5,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Estonian temporary residence permit. Stipends based on academic performance.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Performance-based stipends range from €100 to €300/month (~53,000 - 159,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Housing availability in Tallinn can be tight in August/September.

sat.overall: Optional, can replace entrance math tests if score is high enough.

universities.university_entrance_exams: Online entrance exams in mathematics or program-specific subjects.

universities.name: Vilnius University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €2,500 to €10,000 per year (Medicine up to €10,000).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: National visa (D) and temporary residence permit. State scholarships for non-EU students.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Lithuanian state scholarships provide monthly stipends of ~€200-€300 (~106,000 - 159,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Immigration formalities and verification of foreign educational documents.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Motivation letter and online interview or subject test.

universities.name: Kaunas University of Technology (KTU)
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €3,000 to €4,500 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Lithuanian student visa. Early bird discounts and partial tuition waivers.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Partial fee waivers reduce tuition by 20-50%.
universities.common_problems: Limited part-time job opportunities in Kaunas compared to major Western capitals.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Motivational interview and entrance test in mathematics for engineering.

universities.name: University of Latvia
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €2,500 to €5,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Latvian residence permit. Latvian state scholarships available (~€500/month).
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Latvian state scholarships provide ~€500/month (~265,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Strict embassy visa requirements regarding proof of financial subsistence.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Entrance interview or portfolio review for specialized programs.

universities.name: Riga Technical University (RTU)
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €3,200 to €4,500 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Student visa and residence permit. Tuition fee discounts for high academic performers.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Tuition discounts up to 20-50% based on semester grades.
universities.common_problems: Bureaucratic delays at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs in Latvia.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Online math test or interview for technical programs.

universities.name: University of Maribor
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for non-EU students ranges from €2,500 to €5,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Slovenian residence permit. Subsidized student meals (Šaruni) and student work permits (Študentski servis).
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Subsidized student work permits allow part-time earnings up to €600-€900/month (~318,000 - 477,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Language barrier in smaller towns; limited English undergraduate majors.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Recognition of secondary education certificate; specific faculty tests if applicable.

universities.name: University of Ljubljana
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for non-EU students approx. €3,000 to €7,500 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Slovenian student visa/permit. Local scholarship schemes.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Government and municipal scholarships range from €200 to €400/month (~106,000 - 212,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: High demand for student housing in Ljubljana; competitive enrollment quotas.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Talent tests or specific subject exams for selective programs.

universities.name: Matej Bel University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for English programs approx. €1,500 - €3,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Slovak student residence permit. National scholarship program of the Slovak Republic.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: National scholarship program offers monthly living grants of ~€400 (~212,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Lower international recognition; strict document legalization.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Simple motivation letter or online interview.

universities.name: Comenius University Bratislava
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for English programs ranges from €3,000 to €12,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Slovak residence permit. Stipends for academic excellence.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Excellence stipends reward top students with €500 - €1,500 per year (~265,000 - 795,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Bureaucratic visa extension process every year.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Entrance exams for Medicine and Law (biology/chemistry or logical reasoning tests).

universities.name: University of Debrecen
universities.age_limitations: Must be at least 18 years old by August 31 of the application year for Stipendium Hungaricum.
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €5,500 to €17,000 per year (Medicine is highest).
universities.study_costs_tenge: Approx. 2,915,000 - 9,010,000 KZT per year (Fully covered if awarded Stipendium Hungaricum).
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Hungarian student visa. Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship covers full tuition, monthly stipend (~HUF 43,750 / ~55,000 KZT), and free dorm.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Stipendium Hungaricum provides 100% tuition waiver, free dormitory housing, and monthly stipend (~55,000 KZT/month + medical insurance).
universities.common_problems: Extremely high competition for Stipendium Hungaricum Kazakhstan quota spots; mandatory medical checks.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Written and oral entrance examinations in biology, chemistry, and physics (for medical programs).

universities.name: University of Szeged
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €4,000 to €15,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Stipendium Hungaricum and Visegrad Fund scholarships available.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Stipendium Hungaricum covers tuition, housing, and monthly stipend (~55,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Strict attendance policies in medical and science departments.
universities.university_entrance_exams: University's own entrance test in sciences/English for medical applicants.

universities.name: Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE)
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €2,500 to €6,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Hungarian residence permit. Stipendium Hungaricum partner university.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Stipendium Hungaricum covers full tuition, dorm, and stipend (~55,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Finding affordable private accommodation in Budapest if dorms are full.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Online entrance interview and written test depending on the faculty.

universities.name: University of Zagreb
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for international programs ranges from €3,000 to €8,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Croatian temporary stay permit for study. Limited national scholarships.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Limited government grants up to €2,000/year (~1,060,000 KZT).
universities.common_problems: Complex document legalization and notarization requirements for non-EU students.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Class entrance tests for medicine, veterinary, and arts.

universities.name: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
required_documents: High school leaving certificate with Greek Embassy legalization / Apostille
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition is free for many standard programs even for non-EU students in Greek; English master's charge ~€1,500-€4,000.
universities.study_costs_tenge: Free for standard undergraduate programs (approx. 0 KZT tuition); English graduate programs up to ~2,120,000 KZT/year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Greek student visa (Type D). Greek government scholarships for foreign nationals.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Government scholarships provide monthly stipends of ~€450 (~238,500 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Bureaucratic hurdles with Greek public offices; learning Greek might be required for daily integration.
universities.university_entrance_exams: University admission evaluation based on high school leaving certificates and equivalency.

universities.name: University of Bucharest
required_documents: Letter of Acceptance from Romanian Ministry of Education
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €2,000 to €5,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Romanian long-stay visa for studies. Romanian state scholarships offered via Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: State scholarships cover tuition and monthly living stipend (~€150-€200 or ~79,500 - 106,000 KZT/month).
universities.common_problems: Visa issuance can take considerable time; obtaining Ministry acceptance letter can be delayed.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Letter of acceptance evaluation based on school grades; interview for specific programs.

universities.name: Sofia University St. Kliment Ohridski
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €3,000 to €5,500 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Bulgarian D-visa and residence permit.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Affordable living costs; limited internal merit grants.
universities.common_problems: Administrative delays in immigration service and university paperwork.
universities.university_entrance_exams: High school grade verification and subject interview.

universities.name: Cyprus University of Technology
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from €3,400 to €8,000 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Cyprus student entry permit and visa. University grants and partial fee reductions.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Partial fee reductions up to 20-30% based on academic standing.
universities.common_problems: Strict immigration rules regarding bank guarantees and health checks in Cyprus.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Internal English placement test or interview if certificates are borderline.

universities.name: University of Cyprus
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition for non-EU students approx. €3,400 to €6,800 per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Migration Department student visa. Merit-based tuition waivers.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Merit-based tuition waivers of up to 50% for top academic students.
universities.common_problems: Hot summer climate, limited public transport outside central Nicosia.
universities.university_entrance_exams: Special international student exams or interview set by departments.

universities.name: Kadir Has University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from $6,000 to $10,000 USD per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Turkish student residence permit. Institutional scholarships (up to 50%-100% tuition waivers for high-scoring applicants).
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: Merit scholarships cover 50% to 100% of tuition based on SAT/GPA scores.
universities.common_problems: Fluctuating inflation rates in Turkey affecting daily living expenses.

sat.overall: Accepted and rewarded (SAT total score 1100+ helps secure scholarships).

universities.university_entrance_exams: University's own English proficiency exam (if IELTS/TOEFL not submitted).

universities.name: Altinbas University
universities.study_costs_original: Tuition ranges from $4,000 to $8,000 USD per year.
universities.visa_and_funding_original: Student residence permit. Broad scholarship tiers for CIS/Kazakh students based on GPA.
universities.visa_and_funding_tenge: GPA-based tuition discounts ranging from 25% to 75%.
universities.common_problems: Heavy traffic in Istanbul, adapting to a very large and fast-paced metropolis.

sat.overall: Not strictly required (admissions can rely entirely on high school GPA).

universities.university_entrance_exams: Internal English language preparatory placement test if no certificate is provided.
